messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands still for a moment, then begins to walk slowly forward and slightly to her left, turning her head to look around.","camera":"The camera is positioned at a low angle, looking up at the subject, and remains mostly static with a slight pan to follow her movement.","clothing":"She wears a dark grey, double-breasted military-style uniform with gold buttons, a high collar, a brown belt with a gold buckle, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Her dark hair is pulled back tightly into a high ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a medium-brown complexion, slim build, and a neutral expression.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor paved road or plaza under a concrete overpass or bridge structure, with metal railings, red-and-yellow striped barriers, and a blue sky with light clouds."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman now stands briefly and then walks forward with a relaxed gait, matching the reference motion more closely than the source's original arm-raising/turning action. Her uniform, hair, face, and the outdoor underpass scene remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the woman's current standing/turning action with the walking action demonstrated in the motion reference, while preserving her identity, uniform, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the walking speed and head orientation exactly match the reference motion.
unexpected_changes: The camera appears to pan/track more noticeably as she walks, changing the framing compared with the mostly static source shot.
